Bricks & Milestones launches Solcrest project in North Bengaluru

Real estate developer Bricks & Milestones has launched its new project, Solcrest, located in North Bengaluru. The project is situated in the Thanisandra area. Solcrest is described as a luxury residential development. The launch event was attended by company officials and stakeholders.
